result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor defends and indemnifies Company and its affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Contractor-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, with notice, defence control, and cooperation procedures. It also limits any Company indemnity to Company-provided content and legal violations. The change is targeted and leaves the existing fee-waiver language intact. Drafting is professional, though “and” in the Company-indemnity limitation could more clearly be “or,” and the interaction between indemnified third-party defence costs and the existing attorneys’ fee waiver could be clarified.
